title: Wire runtime/timeline source-ref integration and integrity checks
verify: Successful audited mutations persist authoritative state plus required timeline refs or fail without misleading success.
Runtime records reference source records and timeline events instead of copying bulky blobs.
evidence_required: Integrity tests for missing/mismatched timeline refs.
Integration evidence for CheckIn/photo/admin refs connected to runtime history without authority leakage.
constraints: Timeline append and runtime source refs must preserve source-of-truth separation.
Photo refs, manifests, and timeline refs cannot mutate runtime Plant state by themselves.
invariants: Runtime state source_refs and evidence_refs point to persisted authoritative records.
Timeline replay cannot publish authoritative Bus or Plant-state facts.
verification_targets: Audited mutation integrity: source record plus timeline ref or fail safely.
